stage: post-hoc information-parity check, specified before this added control is computed
reason: Primary non-learning controls use the controlled template's distinction between explicitly missing costs and optional nuisance features. Add a control that does not make that distinction within the selected three features.
inputs: All39 frozen admitted source-seed inputs, same10 test contexts; no new or replaced source, seed or test
metric: Unchanged decision regret; one result per source-seed, no history learning
limits: Same5-second forward solver limit, no worst-face diagnostics for this additional control
comparison: Exploratory paired-by-source contrast against primary text_l1 at K10/noise0.1; full-cohort mean only when every admitted run completes
preservation: Never pool into or overwrite the original nine-method schedule; all failures and resource use kept separately
